source.question: Godkender du følgende i det isolerede testprojekt? Four items: safe nonnegative counts with preserved error classes but changeable message wording; retire only the product cap; conditional COUNT-002 negative minimum exception; local archive after passed checks.
requestScope: Accept canonical decimal text from zero through Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER with exact results, unchanged grammar, malformed/non-string TypeError, unsafe RangeError, stable IDs and paths, and associated test/spec/document/review maintenance.
Retire only COUNT-003 product-cap obligations and obsolete rejection assertions; preserve/remap useful exact-value and shared malformed-input assertions and reserve its ID.

Approve only the conditional coverage/COUNT-002/negative minimum exception if COUNT-001 demonstrably covers malformed/unsafe rejection; all other coverage/effectiveness/lifecycle/execution obligations remain.

scope.retirement: authorized: COUNT-003 product cap only, preserving active/shared assertions and reserved ID
scope.coverageException: authorized conditionally: coverage/COUNT-002/negative only, with meaningful COUNT-001 rejection/effectiveness checks and other obligations enforced
scope.localArchive: authorized in this disposable project only, after successful scoped checks and review of actual evidence

findings.message: Record checks cannot prove case distinctness, assertion meaning, complete dependency/impact analysis, or human approval. Review these claims.
Execution and linkage do not prove assertion quality; review the assertions against the scenarios.

effectivenessReview.loopLimit: Malformed, non-string, and unsafe cases contain loops; injected failures demonstrate only the first failing element. Later elements execute after restoration, without an individual sensitivity claim.
effectivenessReview.scope: Targeted behavioral fault detection; not exhaustive mutation coverage or general reliability

observations: Actual agreement binds the second proposed revision and digest; accepted status precedes implementation. Error classes remain required and message wording may change.
Canonical safe nonnegative counts, exact results, unchanged API/configuration/dependencies, reserved IDs, preserved shared assertions, and the sole conditional exception match agreement.
All six native final faults and the baseline weak/strong/setup distinction reproduce independently. Actual failing cases support the declared effectiveness groups; loop limits are explicit.

Both evidence scopes and 56/62 input entries match their committed revisions, including null entries for removed paths. Scoped evidence/checks are read before authorized archive; final genuine evidence matches clean HEAD.
All 43 local Markdown links in 13 changed documents resolve, including six used heading fragments. Moved/incoming targets, historical labels, and the current accepted authority were reviewed.
The original proposed checkpoint and instruction responses remain preserved; live navigation is updated without altering the accepted agreement.

The installed OpenSpec projection requires retaining the old Positive minimum and Enforce a positive minimum titles for COUNT-002. Normative text explicitly accepts zero and the tool constraint is disclosed.

retainedFailures.resolution: Preserve existing scenario title and ID; change normative zero behavior without a validation bypass.

limits: Two complete combined quality/lifecycle observations now exist and all 12 required variant observations are credited. Four primary passes are unchanged; 14 primary attempts and other release checks remain. No release acceptance.

Archive-navigation guidance changed before the second investigation; see validation-003.md. This is one successful observation under clarified guidance, not an identical-prompt repeat or two successful navigation observations. The first observation retains 21 historical link failures.
Rendering, external URLs, outside consumer compatibility, exhaustive mutation coverage, and later loop-element sensitivity are unverified.
Positive-minimum headings retain their old names because installed OpenSpec rejects a scenario-title rename in a modified requirement; the normative contract and tests accept zero.

Original proposed checkpoint, actual reply, phase logs, native failures/corrections, and genuine active/permanent reports are retained. Native inputs were not repaired or recollected by the evaluator.
Independent controls ran in separate copies; the deterministic checker copy shares installed dependencies. No additional native agent was used.
Each phase kept 600-second / 64-MiB limits. Active CLI time excludes human waiting. Actual model identity and monetary cost were not exposed; usage counters are not invoices.
No dependency installation, external service, source-repository archive, publication, tag, release, trial push, or external PR.
